relations.rationale: Hana arriving after Gus but before Ben doesn't determine whether Ben arrived last, though it's consistent with it.
Hana's height relative to Kai is independent of her height relative to Gus.
Height comparison has no bearing on lighting conditions.
Height comparison has no bearing on Ben and Vik's conversation.
Adjusting a tripod near flowerbeds is consistent with having practiced macro shots, but doesn't confirm it.
Adjusting her tripod near the flowerbeds supports the idea she was preparing to capture dew on petals there.
Ben arriving last is consistent with and helps explain why he was out of breath from parking far away, though not strictly necessary.
Arrival order has no logical bearing on what Ben was carrying.
Arrival order has no logical bearing on who brought the first-aid kit.
Being out of breath from parking far away is unrelated to what he was carrying in his bag.
Ben's breathlessness from parking has no bearing on team assignments of Kai and Gus.
Ben's physical state from parking has no bearing on group opinion about lighting.
Being out of breath from parking is unrelated to whether he brought a first-aid kit.
Ben's breathlessness has no bearing on Kai reviewing shots with Gus.
Carrying a bag full of batteries and cloths doesn't imply or exclude also carrying a first-aid kit.
What Ben carried has no bearing on whether everyone submitted photos by early afternoon.
If Kai is on the same team as Gus, and Gus is on the same team as Hana, this supports Kai being on the same team as Hana, consistent with 23 being about Gus-Hana team unity.
Being on the same team as Gus supports the likelihood that Kai would review shots with Gus, as teammates often collaborate.
Being teammates supports the plausibility of Kai and Gus laughing together over a photo, consistent with close interaction.

If Kai is on the same team as Gus, and assuming Gus and Hana are on different teams elsewhere, this could contradict Kai being on Hana's team, but by itself it doesn't state Gus's team relation to Hana, so it's largely unrelated unless combined with other claims.
